summary: Versioned public release information and source-bound distribution candidates.
changes: Public release notes are generated from one reviewed record and bound to candidate checksums.
Channel descriptions include versioned upgrade, permission, security and limitation information.
Runtime archives carry explicitly approved files and required legal and privacy documents.

Local MCP feedback_start and feedback_resolve open and advance bounded verification chains; feedback_accept checks whether the final report exactly matches the verified artifact, without running a new check or changing the chain.
Feedback corrections retain append-only verification traces and fail closed on inconsistent or tampered chain state.
The compact Claude Code plugin is packaged from a reviewed runtime Git-blob allowlist with reproducible ZIP bytes.
Literal GitHub citations in Markdown reports can be checked against pinned GitHub file, pull request and diff evidence.
upgrade: Install buddie==2.0.2 with pip or select the matching approved plugin or Desktop bundle. Existing PyPI 2.0.1 artifacts remain unchanged.
permissions: No new runtime permissions are required. Local checks run without a model. GitHub anchors may use optional GitHub credentials; browser access is optional and requires a separate browser installation.
security: Release candidates bind public notes and Registry payloads to the recorded source revision and file digests. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md.
limitations: Checks support evidence review and do not establish that every claim is true. Catalog display of release notes is unverified; publication and plugin promotion require separate authorization.
